name: Buckwheat
harvestProduct: green manure / pollinator cover, killed before seed shatter

daysToHarvestRange.notes: No SA-specific source with a day-count to flowering/termination was found; only the FAO ECOCROP generic growing-cycle range below.

evidence.doc: Buckwheat product page, Barenbrug South Africa

evidence.quote: Buckwheat is a valuable cover crop known for its rapid growth. It is often employed to suppress summer annual weeds and enhance soil quality within short windows, particularly between warm-season crops or during the transitional phases between winter and summer annuals.
evidence.doc: Buckwheat product page, Barenbrug South Africa

gaps: No SA sow-month/calendar window found — only a qualitative description of use as a fast 'gap filler' between warm- and cool-season crops.
No row/in-row spacing or sow-depth figures found.

No SA-specific biomass, yield, or days-to-termination figures found. General cover-crop guides (e.g. SARE, Johnny's Selected Seeds, eOrganic) give '4-5 weeks to flower, 10-12 weeks to maturity' but these are US/general gardening sources, not on the brief's acceptable list, and were only seen as search-summary text, never opened and quoted, so they are excluded per the no-invented-numbers rule.
Only one commercial SA source (Barenbrug) was found for buckwheat at all; Agricol/Advance Seed/Du Toit Agri searches returned nothing buckwheat-specific.
summary: Only a seed rate (50 kg/ha, Barenbrug) and the FAO ECOCROP climate envelope could be substantiated from an acceptable source. Sow months, spacing, biomass, yield and days-to-termination are all gaps — no DAFF/ARC/Grain SA/FAO/scielo document treating buckwheat as an SA cover crop was located.
